almostIncluded.description:
Sacrifice Saffi Eriksdotter targeting Loyal Retainers.
Sacrifice Loyal Retainers to return Saffi to the battlefield.
Return Loyal Retainers to the battlefield.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.

almostIncluded.description:
Deal damage to Apex Altisaur, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Apex Altisaur is dealt damage by the creature, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Repeat step 2.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
Hammer of Nazahn attached to Apex Altisaur.
You have a way to deal damage to Apex Altisaur.

feature.name: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature token with haste

almostIncluded.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Enduring Scalelord with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Enduring Scalelord.
The Enduring Scalelord who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Enduring Scalelord.
Helm of the Host attached to Enduring Scalelord.

Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Aurelia.
Declare the token Aurelia as an attacker.
The token Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare the token Combat Celebrant as an attacker choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Combat Celebrant.

feature.name: Put all Equipment cards from your library onto the battlefield

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Godo with haste.
The token Godo enters the battlefield, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Declare the token Godo as an attacker.
The token Godo triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Godo.

feature.name: Infinite tapped creature tokens until end of turn

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a non-legendary copy of Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the untapped non-legendary Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Repeat step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Kiki-Jiki.

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Port Razer with haste.
Declare the Port Razer token as an attacker.
When the Port Razer token deals combat damage, it triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get another combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Port Razer.
An opponent is unable to block Port Razer.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Scourge of the Throne with haste.
Declare the Scourge of the Throne token as an attacker, attacking the opponent with the most life or an opponent that is tied for the most life.
The Scourge of the Throne token's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, giving the token +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at most five.
You have the lowest life total or are tied for the lowest life total.

feature.name: Infinite untap of modified creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Akki Battle Squad with haste.
Declare another modified creature you control as an attacker.
Akki Battle Squad triggers, untapping all modified creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You control another modified creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Akki Battle Squad.

feature.name: Near-infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Near-infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out with haste.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Declare the token Fear of Missing Out as an attacker. It triggers, untapping another creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of the creature it is attached to with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the token created in step 1, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to any creature except the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Go to combat, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the token copy of Timestream Navigator to take an extra turn.
Move to next turn.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Timestream Navigator.
You have the City's Blessing.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least eight foreshadow counters on it

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Ominous Seas by removing eight foreshadow counters from it, creating a 8/8 Kraken creature token.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the Kraken token, drawing eight cards and discarding three cards.
Ominous Seas triggers eight times, putting eight foreshadow counters on itself.
Repeat

Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of cards in your library.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to draw cards equal to the Fractal's power, then discard three cards.

feature.name: Opponents can't cast instant spells during their turns

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Azor with haste.
The Azor token enters the battlefield, preventing opponents from casting instants or sorceries during their next turn.
Repeat each turn.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Azor.

feature.name: Near-infinite untap of some creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Greater Good by sacrificing another creature with power one or greater.
If the creature was a Tentacle, The Watcher triggers, untapping up to one Kraken you control and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Greater Good ability, causing you to draw cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power and then discard three cards.
For each card drawn this way, The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating that many 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
You control at least one other creature with power one or greater.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing a creature with power 1 or greater, causing you to to draw cards equal to the creature's power and then discard three cards.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token for each card discarded.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conduit of Worlds by tapping it, allowing you to cast Second Chance from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
